page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, with page number at top left. Two circular portrait medallions with inscriptions across the top, centred. Below them, one column of full-width text in two paragraphs. No margin notes.

main_text.l: R. FRAN. 15 THEODORICVS
R. FRAN. 16 CLODOVEVS
THEODORICVS, huius nominis primus,ac Franco-
rum Rex decimusquintus,qui iam post Clotariū tertium, ferè
annum regnarat,& ob scelera in monasterium detrusus fuerat,
perempto Childerico, è monastica vita revocatus,à Francis in
solium reponitur,anno mundi 4641. à Christo nato 679. Len-
desius,Ercembaldi filius,Magister equitum creatur. Ebroinus,
tandē relicto monachatu,ingenti sceleratorum manu collecta,
inopinātes hostes magna celeritate opprimit.Gaza capta, Rex
ægrè effugit initiō:mòxq; se Ebroino cōmittit, Magistro equi-
tum ab se dicto, & periculorū socio:medio in colloquio truci-
datur Lendesius ab Ebroino. Ita sublato adversario, Ebroinus
unus rebus, Regíque præest:sæuítq; in eos quos sibi in calami-
tate insultasse sentit,nec dignitati,nec sanctitati cuiusquā par-
cit. Pipini dein,& Martini,fratrū, Austrasianorū Ducum acies
fundit Ebroinus,contráq; fidem datam Martinum occidit.tan-
démque occiditur ipse,ab Ermēfredo in Martini ultionē. Mo-
ritur Rex anno regni 14.qui à Pipino victus, fugatúsque fuerat
ante paucos annos:tum Pipinus Palatij curā suscipiēs,multum
res Francorum auxit. Vide Gag. lib. 3. Æmy.lib.1.Rex Atreba-
tibus sepelitur in D.Vedasti æde.
CLODOVEVS,huius nominis tertius,Francorum Rex
16.succedit patri Theodorico anno mundi 4655.à Christo nato
693. Hic brevis æui,moriens post annos quatuor,fratrem suum
Childebertum regni successorē habuit. Claret venerabilis Be-
da.Frisij,Rabodo eorum Duce superato, in Christianismum à
Pipino inducūtur:apud quos Vullibrotus,quem nonnulli Cle-
mentem Papam vocant,frequētes de Christi verbo conciones
habuit,eósque instituit. Vide Chro.Reg.Fran.

page.notes: The two medallion inscriptions ("R. FRAN. 15 THEODORICVS", "R. FRAN. 16 CLODOVEVS") are printed around the portraits and are transcribed as lines. The second paragraph begins with an indent. The first paragraph is printed as one block with the broken words "Franco-rum", "tan-démque" and "Atreba-tibus" and "Mo-ritur" (its first line is not a broken word). The printed spelling "vnus", "vltionē", "aduersario", "reuocatus", "breuis" and "Frifij" has been normalised for u/v and long s only; "Frifij" has been read as "Frisij", which is a probable reading.
